propositions: Reconciler asymmetry policies (should_propagate_removal gate, add-wins tag dedup, field canonicalization) are scattered across four call sites with no single declarative source, causing parity bugs to escape testing.
A new _field_contract.py registry must enumerate all reconciled fields with their symmetry class (bidirectional-roundtrip, add-wins, one-way-with-propagation-gate) and codec/gate references.

Property tests parameterized off the registry must assert roundtrip identity only for declared-bidirectional codecs, add-wins idempotence, and gate-consulted behavior, with a coverage guard that fails collection if any handled field lacks a registry entry.
The property tests must validate code behavior against declared symmetry classes through real call paths without refactoring existing call sites to import the registry.
